notes.title: French Localization
notes.notes: I'm excited to announce that Void Whispers has been localized into French, thanks to the incredible help of Miel/M.E. We now have a French version available for our French-speaking players. I hope you all enjoy the experience. Thank you!

notes.title: Lighting Update
notes.notes: Slight adjustment to overall contrast and brightness in the game

notes.title: Korean Localization + Picture Mode
notes.notes: Hi, everyone! Void Whispers now has Korean localization thanks to 손셩. Additionally, I've added a picture mode for taking better screenshots; to toggle the picture mode, simply press F2. Thanks!

notes.title: Italian Localization + Discord Server
notes.notes:
First of all, thank you all for the support and the reviews. It's incredible to see my work being enjoyed by others. Now, regarding the updates: I have added an Italian localization to the game with the incredible help of Domenico Colaprico.

Additionally, we now have a Discord server. If you enjoyed the game and want to stay in touch or keep updated about future projects, hop into my Discord server.

[url=https://discord.gg/Ep5pzTQjvQ]Discord Server[/url]

Thank you!
